observations.detail: Synthetic name -> rectangular room -> 30 participants -> Create. Generated green mat layout and 3D room visibly rendered.
Chair library button -> Place -> Done. Inspector initially showed X=600 cm, Z=480 cm.

observations.step: Edit via locator fill and Tab
observations.detail: Inputs displayed QA chair and X=720, but reopening showed the original chair name and X=600. Do not count input values alone as successful model mutation.

observations.step: Reload and reopen project on mobile
observations.detail: Project appeared in My Projects as one project, rectangular room, 30 people. Open restored layout; scene and mobile layout tools rendered at 390x844 without document horizontal overflow.

observations.step: Retry with actual keyboard typing and Tab
observations.detail: Typed QA chair and 720 into selected chair fields. Subsequent reload visibly retained the chair in its new position. Exact inspector values after this final reload were not rechecked; no definitive persistence defect is claimed.

acceptance.reason: Partial evidence only: complete drag behavior, final numeric persistence, error recovery, touch interactions and full acceptance/security review remain unverified.

nextTask: Reopen the synthetic project, confirm final chair name/X/Z via inspector, then test drag and undo/redo on desktop and mobile before promoting any gate.
